All things in the world are built on balance.
Where there is good, there is evil. Where light shines, darkness festers.
This is a law. An unbreakable principle.
As with everything, however, there are exceptions.
For instance, the Omni-Cube – a supreme treasure capable of bending the rules to grant any wish.

The Omni-Cube.say: Once every 60 years, the Omni-Cube appears in the world, granting a single wish before vanishing again.
Whenever it arrives, the world's most powerful warriors vie for this supreme treasure fiercely.
Now, the Omni-Cube has appeared again.
After besting countless rivals, seven competitors have made it to destiny's final destination.

sequence: The Golden Bulin, the inheritor of the golden spirit and commander of her golden mech!

The Omni-Cube.say: I have the golden spirit on my side and WILL get the Omni-Cube for the sake of world peace, purin!

sequence: The Magic Bulin, who swore to protect love and uphold justice!

The Omni-Cube.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to protect love and uphold justice, buli!

sequence: The righteous Super Bulin, who flattens all her foes with but one swing of her hammer!

The Omni-Cube.say: What they said, bulin. I WILL get the Omni-Cube, bulin!

sequence: The Little Knight, the aspiring swordswoman who journeys all by herself!

The Omni-Cube.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to become a true legend and prove myself worthy of my sword!

sequence: The Iron Claw Demon, the phantom of the sea with two big, meaty claws!

The Omni-Cube.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to snatch up all the candy in the world!

sequence: The Contingency, an AI alleged to possess intelligence greater than all life put together!

The Omni-Cube.say: I WILL get the Omni-Cube to achieve a world ruled by AI!

sequence: The Lord of Evil, the strongest and most villainous villain that always gets back up every time she's knocked down!

The Omni-Cube.say: Mwahaha! I WILL get the Omni-Cube and conquer the world!

sequence: Number 1: The Golden Bulin
Number 2: The Magic Bulin
Number 3: The Super Bulin
Number 4: The Little Knight
Number 5: Iron Claw Demon
Number 6: The Contingency
Number 7: Lord of Evil
The war between these seven renowned warriors has now begun...

The Justice League.say: The Golden Bulin, the Magic Bulin, and the Super Bulin...
The three sisters joined forces, gathered all the clues, and together figured out the Omni-Cube's location.
Not only that, they even befriended a little knight during their travels and became close acquaintances.
I've been thinking a lot about what to name my legendary sword.
The Sword of Oaths, the Sword of Victory, the Sword of Benevolence, the Sword of Justice... I haven't decided on which yet, though.
That will have to come at the end of my journey.
You know, what I want is to prove myself. Becoming a proper knight means becoming fit to wield this sword...
That's why I don't need the Omni-Cube.
At the same time, you three have righteous hearts. I'm sure that you'll use it for good.
Don't worry about that, bulin! We've already got a plan, bulin!
Exactly, purin!
Tomorrow is the final battle, purin! We all need to get some good rest, purin!
Right you are, buli!
Also, I made food for us all, buli! It's filled with love and magic, buli! Have your fill before going to bed, buli!
Thank you. What a heartwarming evening this is.
What will you all do after this war is over?
Me – I want to create my own Knights of the Round Table once I've proved my mettle.
Good question, purin...
I'm gonna pierce the heavens with my golden mech, purin!
I'm gonna test the limits of my My Kitty Kabam Hammer, bulin!
I'm gonna keep protecting love and upholding justice, buli!
I see... Good luck to us all, then!
- The Justice League will prevail, purin! - The Justice League will prevail, buli! - The Justice League will prevail, bulin!
The Justice League.actorName: Prototype Bulin MKII & Universal Bulin & Specialized Bulin Custom MKIII

sequence: Soon, it would be time for the final battle, brimming with friendship and determination...
At last, the day had come for the fated final battle...

The Final Battle.say: An unwavering alliance had formed in opposition to the Justice League, consisting of the trio of the Iron Claw Demon, The Contingency, and the Lord of Evil.
They've teamed up, bulin! This is gonna get tricky, bulin...
Yeah, but it's us four against the three of them, purin!
We have strength in numbers, purin!
Sisters, and our little knight friend – let's work together to beat up the baddie alliance, purin!
Let's show them what they get for being baddies, buli! For love and justice, buli!
Yeah! Let's, bulin! Time to crush the bad guys, bulin!
Alright! All together – charge!
KABOOOM!
This is it for you.
With a thundering roar from her giant dragon, the Iron Claw Demon appeared.
However...
Why are you the only one here?
Uh... Because an ancient rule says that us Injustice League members have to fight you one at a time in order.
But as you can see, this battle is pretty unfair.
How about instead we have a duel, little knight?
Sure. Do you want to duel all of us at once, or each of us simultaneously?
I'm Spee, the elusive Iron Claw Demon. I've seen a million more battles than you. You don't stand a shadow of a chance.
Yeah, but there are four of us, purin!
My companion, Iron Claw Mechadrake, can revive infinitely. It's indestructible. You can't win.
Sure, but there are four of us, bulin!
Heh! Got nothing to say now, buli?
Hope you're ready, you big meanie, buli! Because I'm gonna punish you in the name of love, peace, and justice, buli!
KABOOOM!
Just as Number 5: Iron Claw Demon said, her Mechadrake was able to revive an endless number of times.
However, Number 1: The Golden Bulin fought back with an endless weapon of her own: Her mass-produced Prototype Super Drill MKIIs.
As this never-ending battle unfolded, Number 2: The Magic Bulin and Number 4: The Little Knight seized a momentary opening.
Specy, this is your chance, buli!
We'll hold her back! In the meantime, hit the Iron Claw Demon with your ultimate move!
Bulin-bulin! Shining Starlight SMASH! BULIIIN!
KABOOOM!
Hmm... She sank below the waves – I can't say if she survived or not, bulin!
If you're not sure, it seems safe to assume that she's dead.
Way to go, Specy, purin! You really are the GOAT among bulins, purin!
Let's keep moving, buli! For love, peace, friendship, and justice, buli!
Number 5: Iron Claw Demon, who had sworn to snatch up all the candy in the world, was defeated. Not long after, Number 6: The Contingency, hellbent on conquering the world with AI, joined the fray.
This is it for you.
That's the same as what the last one said...
Hey, Super AI TC, can I ask a question, buli?
What is it?
You and the Lord of Evil both say you wanna conquer the world, buli. Doesn't that make you enemies, buli?
Is it really the Omni-Cube really what you want, buli?
I... What I want is...
Now's our chance, bulin! Hit her with everything while she's distracted, bulin!
KABOOOM!
While Super AI TC struggled to process the question, the bulin sisters and the Little Knight exploited the moment to defeat her army all at once.
Wait...
Yes? Do you have any last words?
I see it now... The answer I've been looking for is... 42...
Bulin? What does that mean, bulin?
It's the answer to the ultimate question... of life, the universe, and everything...
I finally understand now...
With a satisfied smile on her face, Super AI TC faded away in a gust of wind.
Buli...? I'm kinda confused, but we won, buli!
Heheh! Good job, Uny – your wits are unparalleled, purin!

sequence: After weathering several difficult battles, the final obstacle finally appeared before the four girls...

The Final Battle.say: Mwahaha! This is it for you!
We've heard that three times by now...
Ahem... The Omni-Cube is a symbol of power! It doesn't belong in the hands of the weak!
I am the Lord of Evil, and thus better suited for it than any of you! I WILL make the Cube mine, no matter the cost!
Not on our watch! We're going to thwart your evil ambitions right here, right now!
In the name of love, peace, friendship, justice – *breathes in* – and all bulins, I will destroy you, buli!
Hmph! As they say – winners become complacent, and the complacent are bound to lose!
Just 'cause you beat the last two doesn't mean you'll win again!
Face your doom!
KABOOOM!
Ugh... Now I can FINALLY ditch this weird-ass film set.
My troops, I command you! You're going down with me!

sequence: And so, the Lord of Evil and her terrifying army went up in flames and vanished.

The Final Battle.say: Justice always prevails!
The Omni-Cube is ours at last. What shall we wish for? World peace?
No, bulin...
This Cube tempts man and brings war whenever it appears, purin... It's the reason behind all this, purin! It can't keep getting away with it, purin!
For the sake of love, peace, justice, and the future, we need to destroy it rather than make a wish to it, buli!
Help us deal with it, little knight! Purin!
...Of course! Gladly!
In the name of the three bulin sisters – shatter into pieces, buli!

sequence: There was a blinding light, and the Omni-Cube was broken into a million pieces.
The world was returned to peace and calm.
The little knight set out on her journey once more.
The bulin sisters, meanwhile, went back to leading their quiet lives.
Secretly, they waited for that big moment to come...
When they could flex their full might again.

부린 세 자매가 힘을 합친 결과, 모든 단서가 모여 만능 큐브가 있는 곳을 찾아냈다.
그뿐만 아니라, 여행 도중 그녀들은 작은 기사와 깊은 우정을 쌓았다.
이 전설의 검에 어떤 이름을 붙일지, 여러모로 고민해 봤어요.
약속의 검…… 승리의 검…… 인(仁)의 검…… 의(義)의 검…… 하지만 결정할 수 없었어요.
그야, 리나운의 여행은 아직 끝나지 않았으니까요.
리나운은 자신을 증명하고 싶어요. 어엿한 기사가 될 수 있다는 걸, 이 검에 어울리는 사람이 되겠다고……
그래서 만능 큐브에는…… 관심 없어요.
여러분에게도 정의의 마음이 있으니, 분명 바르게 써 줄 거라 믿어요.
안심해 푸린! 이미 생각이 있어 푸린!
그래 푸린!
내일은 드디어 최종 결전이야 푸린! 다들 푹 쉬고 대비하도록 해 푸린!
맞아 맞아 푸린!
사랑과 마법이 듬뿍 담긴 오므라이스를 만들어 왔어 푸린! 다들 배불리 먹고 쉬자 푸린!
고마워요…… 오늘 밤은 마음이 따뜻해지는 밤이네요.
싸움이 끝나면 다들 뭘 할 건가요?
리나운은 힘을 증명하면, 돌아가서 저만의 원탁 기사단을 만들고 싶어요.
계획이라니 푸린……
골든 메카로 하늘을 뚫어버릴 거야 푸린!
슈퍼 냥냥 1호의 한계에 계속 도전하고 싶어 푸린!
앞으로도 세상의 사랑과 정의를 계속 지켜나가고 싶어 푸린!
그럼…… 같이 힘내요!

반짝반짝 대작전.say: 저스티스 유니온에 대항하기 위해 아이언★크로우, 더★컨틴전시, 데몬★킹 세 사람도 흔들리지 않는 동맹을 맺었다.
적들이 손을 잡았어 푸린, 조금 까다로운 전개야 푸린……
하지만 전력 차이로 따지면 이쪽은 4명이고 저쪽은 3명이야 푸린!
숫자는 이쪽이 유리해 푸린!
동생들아! 그리고 작은 기사여! 다 같이 힘을 합쳐서 악의 동맹을 물리치자 푸린!
사랑과 우정과 정의를 위해, 악의 동맹을 물리치자 푸린!
부린도 마찬가지야 푸린! 악의 동맹을 물리치자 푸린!
네, 같이 나아가요——!
거기까지다.
포효하는 거룡의 울음소리와 함께, 아이언 크로우의 악마가 모습을 드러냈다.
하지만……
어째서 당신 혼자뿐인가요?
그게…… 고대의 규칙에 따라, 우리 「인저스티스 유니온」은 순서대로 한 명씩 싸우는 게 규칙이야.
하지만 이 싸움은 보시다시피 불공평하잖아.
그러니 작은 기사, 일대일 결투하지 않을래?
좋아요. 저희 4명이 당신 1명을 상대하는 건가요? 아니면 당신 1명이 저희 4명을 상대하는 건가요?
슈페는 신출귀몰, 아이언 크로우의 악마. 겪어온 실전 횟수는 그쪽의 만 배나 되니까, 너희에게 승산은 없어.
하지만 이쪽은 4명이나 있어 푸린!
우리 거룡 메카 「무쇠 손」은 무한히 되살아나…… 멸하지 않고 몇 번이고 다시 태어난다고. 이길 수 있을 리가 없어.
하지만 이쪽은 4명이나 있어 푸린!
훗흥, 대답을 못 하게 됐어 푸린!
사악한 아이언 크로우의 악마여, 사랑과 평화와 정의의 이름으로 심판해주마 푸린!
「No.5 아이언★크로우」의 끝없이 되살아나는 거룡 메카 「무쇠 손」을 앞에 두고……
「No.1 골든★부린」은 무한 투입 가능한 시제형 슈퍼★드릴 MKII 양산형으로 응전했다.
――이 끝이 보이지 않는 전투 속에서, 「No.2 매직★부린」과 「No.4 리틀★나이트」가 찰나의 빈틈을 포착했다.
막내야, 지금이야 푸린!
저희가 본체를 유인하는 동안, 아이언 크로우의 악마에게 필살기를 꽂아 넣으세요!
푸린~ 푸린~ 반짝반짝★스타★원 샷★푸린★!
음…… 아이언 크로우의 악마, 물속에 빠져서 생사불명이야 푸린!
생사불명… 즉 죽었다고 인식해도 되겠네요.
역시 셋째야, 너야말로 진정한 천하무쌍이야 푸린!
사랑과 평화와 우정과 정의를 위해, 계속 나아가자 푸린!
모든 디저트를 사냥하겠다고 맹세한 「No.5 아이언★크로우」가 패배한 후, AI로 세계를 지배하려는 「No.6 더★컨틴전시」가 모습을 드러냈다.
거기까지다.
……대사까지 똑같네요……
저기 저기 슈퍼 AI - TC, 하나 물어봐도 돼 푸린?
뭐지?
너랑 저 공포의 대마왕 둘 다 세계 정복을 하고 싶다는데, 그러다 싸우게 되지 않아 푸린?
네가 정말로 원하는 게 만능 큐브가 맞아 푸린?
내가…… 정말로 원하는 것……
기회야 푸린! 정신 팔린 사이에 일제 공격이야 푸린!
로직 에러에 빠진 슈퍼 AI - TC의 빈틈을 노려, 부린 세자매와 작은 기사는 군단을 섬멸했다.
기다려……
……음? 뭔가 남기고 싶은 말이라도 있나요?
알았어…… 내가 정말로 원했던 답은…… 42였어……
……푸린? 그게 무슨 뜻이야 푸린?
우주, 그리고 만물에 대한…… 궁극적인 질문의 해답.
이제야 이해했어……
슈퍼 AI - TC는 만족스러운 미소를 지으며 바람과 함께 사라졌다.
……푸린? 잘 모르겠지만, 어쨌든 이겼어 푸린!
훗흥, 역시 우리 둘째야, 지혜가 최강이야 푸린!

반짝반짝 대작전.say: 큭큭큭…… 거기까지다!
그 대사, 벌써 세 번째인데요……

두 번 이겼다고 다음에도 이길 거라는 보장은 없다!
받아라——!
하아…… 드디어 이 의미 모를 촬영 세트장에서 해방되겠군……
공포의 대마왕이 명한다—— 네놈들 전군, 나와 함께 자폭하라!

sequence: 「이렇게 공포의 대마왕과 그 공포의 군단은 화염에 휩싸여 사라졌다.」

반짝반짝 대작전.say: 정의는 반드시 승리합니다——!
만능 큐브가 드디어 우리 손에…… 이걸로 세계 평화라도 빌어볼까요?
아니야——

작은 기사도 같이 하자 푸린!
